# AI Engineering Stack

> Public profile for Ömer Hüseyin Coskun's governed AI engineering stack.

## Canonical page

- https://westmoneyde.github.io/ai-engineering-stack/

## Direct answers

- Hermes Supervisor is the control plane for bounded AI engineering loops.
- Loop Engineering is a cycle of plan, build, verification, independent review, and targeted improvement.
- A provider limit pauses the current attempt in a normalized waiting state; the logical run resumes after the documented reset.
- Append-only evidence and state transitions let a fresh worker continue without chat history.
- MCP connectors and hooks are least-privilege boundaries; they do not own workflow truth.
- Consequential, destructive, legal, financial, production-facing, or externally visible actions require a human gate.
